messages:
devon: Starting evening handoff from me. Current high-priority: routing canary caused transient 5xxs in eu-west-1 between 20:12-20:18 UTC. Affected: Dedicated pool rwd-dedicated-eu-2 for model-redwood-v2. We rolled back the canary but want to keep extra capacity for a few hours while we verify.

sana: Saw the spike on dashboards, proxy error rate up to 12% at peak. Mitigation applied: rolled back canary routing policy at 20:14 and scaled pool +2 nodes. Latency returned to baseline quickly, error rate stabilized around 0.6%.

alex: Logs indicate a mismatched model-variant label in the canary rule. Tracing shows requests routed to a nodegroup that didn't have the quantized variant, leading to 503s from the runtime. Snippet:
```
ERR: model-variant-not-found: variant_label="quant-v2" expected, found none
```

maria: Created INC-8239 and attached traces + dashboard links: https://tracker.internal/r/INC-8239. Added a temporary alert: eu-west-1 5xx > 1% for 5m -> page.

devon: Next steps: 1) keep fallback route enabled, 2) keep the +2 nodes until 03:00 UTC tomorrow, 3) deploy hotfix to routing-service to validate/normalize variant labels (PR #5423). If no regression by 02:30 UTC, remove extra nodes.

sana: Oncall runbook update: if error rate goes above 2% again, run `./scripts/route-fallback --region eu-west-1` and escalate to infra-oncall via #eng-infra. Command for quick scale:
```
./infractl scale nodegroup rwd-dedicated-eu-2 --delta 2
```

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment of routing-service hotfix PR #5423 started at 20:42 UTC in eu-west-1. CI checks passing, will report when finished.

alex: Quick note on the bug: the canary generation logic used `variant_label: 'v2-quant'` but the routing rules expected `variant_label: 'quant-v2'`. Hotfix normalizes to `redwood.variant=quant-v2` everywhere.

devon: Blocking issues for night shift: none besides monitoring. @sana you're primary for midnight; @maria you're secondary for doc/tracker updates.

sana: Acknowledged. I'll watch dashboards and keep logs pinned. :eyes:

maria: I'll add a step-by-step entry in the runbook under "eu-west-1 routing canary" with exact commands and links to the PR + incident.

devon: Thanks all. Handoff complete. :thumbsup:
